newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA RAISES FUEL PRICES 21-26 PCT.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA RAISES FUEL PRICES 21-26 PCT.

text.p: Bulgaria's cabinet raised petrol and diesel prices for the second time in as many weeks after the lev fell sharply against the dollar, state news agensy BTA said.
Petrol prices rose by an average of 21 percent and diesel fuel prices by 26 percent, effective Tuesday, BTA said, quoting a statement from the government's National Price Commission.
Petrol prices rose to 171-226 levs per litre from 141-186 levs and the price of diesel fuel gained to 141 levs from 112.
The lev traded at 515-530 to the dollar on Tuesday from 355 on November 28 when petrol prices were increased by an average 10 percent and diesel by nine percent.
In January, when the lev traded at around 70 per dollar, average petrol prices were 27.25 levs per litre and diesel was 19.50 levs per litre.
The prices of fuels include value added tax of 22 percent. -- Sofia Newsroom +3592 84561
